items.title: Has Aptiv (APTV) Fallen Far Enough To Look Undervalued?
items.summary: Aptiv stock has fallen sharply over the past few years and the share price now sits well below previous levels. However, the current valuation checks give a more mixed picture rather than a clear bargain or clear overvaluation. Aptiv shares have declined 66.8% over the past 5 years, which raises the question of whether recent pricing now reflects overly low expectations for the business. items.title: This Is the Worst Stock In the S&P 500 Today
items.summary: On Tuesday, the provider of software and hardware for automotive safety and self-driving applications reported second-quarter earnings per share of $1.63 from sales of $3.3 billion.  For the third quarter, Aptiv seeks earnings per share of about $1.30.  The stock lost 16.6%, closing at $47.72 and taking the title of worst in the S&P 500 for the day, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
